nafe17070c9.headline: 'Ready for both': Canadians prepare for any outcome as Trump declares victory

ncb439b4fe3.summary: Wall Street is anticipating possible lower taxes, deregulation and a president quick to comment on markets as Donald Trump returns to the White House. Tariffs are also a key concern.
ncb439b4fe3.why: The S&P 500 tracks large U.S. companies and is the main benchmark for U.S. equity performance. Trade policy and tax changes directly affect corporate earnings and sector valuations.

n492f6a7031.why_moved: The election result points to expected lower taxes and higher tariffs, along with questions about the US central bank's independence, which investors weigh for growth, inflation and trade-exposed sectors.
